title: The Renaissance
text: The Renaissance, spanning roughly the 14th to 17th centuries and originating in Italy, was a period of renewed interest in classical art, literature, and learning following the Middle Ages. It produced landmark achievements in art (Leonardo da Vinci, Michelangelo), science (Galileo, Copernicus), and philosophy (humanism), and coincided with the invention of the printing press, which accelerated the spread of knowledge across Europe.
